title: Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect
description:
Overview

Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect — Location: Brazil / Argentina (Remote). Long term contract.

Job Summary

We are seeking a visionary Automation Senior Cloud Solution Architect to lead the technical design and implementation of this transformative capability. This role is pivotal in architecting a scalable, AI-driven solution that seamlessly integrates advanced data processing, intuitive web interfaces, and intelligent automation.

This position demands a strategic leader who thrives in complexity and is deeply committed to cultivating strong stakeholder relationships. You will play a key role in fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration, guiding cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that drive pricing transparency, operational efficiency, and market competitiveness.

The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of technical depth and strategic foresight, with a proven track record of leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver end-to-end automation at scale. The role with interface with Enterprise Architecture, Business leaders, Senior Leaders and Cyber / Privacy / Legal teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI / CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.

Key Qualifications and Experiences

Technical Expertise

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency : Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI / CD : Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI / CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design : Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP / REST) and API development.
  • NET Development Skills : Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework.   • Disciplina de ferramentas: Jira (backlog, prazos, status, dashboards) e Confluence (documentação, atas, decisões) como fontes únicas de verdade.

  • Domínio prático de Jira e Confluence.
  • Inglês fluente (falado e escrito): dailys, relatórios e apresentações mensais a stakeholders; calls com fornecedores e parceiros.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento de frameworks de gestão (OKRs, RACI, SLAs).

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.

Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.

How your day will look like / Job responsibility

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends

Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships

Knowledge

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors

Skills

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)

Attitude

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

description:
Overview

You could be the one who changes everything for our 28 million members as a clinical professional on our Medical Management/Health Services team. Centene is a diversified, national organization offering competitive benefits including a fresh perspective on workplace flexibility.

We\'re Hiring: Full-time Medical Directors

Centene Corporation is a leading provider of government-sponsored healthcare coverage, providing access to affordable, high-quality services to Medicaid and Medicare members, as well as to individuals and families served by the Health Insurance Marketplace.

Looking for a compelling opportunity to move beyond patient encounters and drive meaningful change in the community?

Qualifications

  • MD or DO without restrictions
  • Must be licensed in New York
  • Board certified in Internal Medicine or Family Medicine
  • Utilization Management experience and knowledge of quality accreditation standards.
  • Actively practices medicine

Position Purpose

Assist the Chief Medical Director to direct and coordinate the medical management, quality improvement and credentialing functions for the business unit.

Responsibilities

  • Provides medical leadership of all for utilization management, cost containment, and medical quality improvement activities.
  • Performs medical review activities pertaining to utilization review, quality assurance, and medical review of complex, controversial, or experimental medical services, ensuring timely and quality decision making.
  • Supports effective implementation of performance improvement initiatives for capitated providers.
  • Assists Chief Medical Director in planning and establishing goals and policies to improve quality and cost-effectiveness of care and service for members.
  • Provides medical expertise in the operation of approved quality improvement and utilization management programs in accordance with regulatory, state, corporate, and accreditation requirements.
  • Assists the Chief Medical Director in the functioning of the physician committees including committee structure, processes, and membership.
  • Conduct regular rounds to assess and coordinate care for high-risk patients, collaborating with care management teams to optimize outcomes.
  • Collaborates effectively with clinical teams, network providers, appeals team, medical and pharmacy consultants for reviewing complex cases and medical necessity appeals.
  • Participates in provider network development and new market expansion as appropriate.
  • Assists in the development and implementation of physician education with respect to clinical issues and policies.
  • Identifies utilization review studies and evaluates adverse trends in utilization of medical services, unusual provider practice patterns, and adequacy of benefit/payment components.
  • Identifies clinical quality improvement studies to assist in reducing unwarranted variation in clinical practice in order to improve the quality and cost of care.
  • Interfaces with physicians and other providers in order to facilitate implementation of recommendations to providers that would improve utilization and health care quality.
  • Reviews claims involving complex, controversial, or unusual or new services in order to determine medical necessity and appropriate payment.

About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.

Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. Attitude

Overview

Job Summary

We are seeking a visionary Automation Senior Cloud Solution Architect to lead the technical design and implementation of this transformative capability. This role is pivotal in architecting a scalable, AI-driven solution that seamlessly integrates advanced data processing, intuitive web interfaces, and intelligent automation.

This position demands a strategic leader who thrives in complexity and is deeply committed to cultivating strong stakeholder relationships. You will play a key role in fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration, guiding cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that drive pricing transparency, operational efficiency, and market competitiveness.

The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of technical depth and strategic foresight, with a proven track record of leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver end-to-end automation at scale. The role with interface with Enterprise Architecture, Business leaders, Senior Leaders and Cyber / Privacy / Legal teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI / CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.

Key Qualifications and Experiences

Technical Expertise :

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI / CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI / CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP / REST) and API development.
  • .NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.
  • Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.
  • Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.
  • Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.
  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.

Specialized Skills

  • Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.
  • Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.
  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.

Soft Skills and Others

  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

title: Head of Cloud Curriculum
description:
About DataCamp

DataCamp's mission is to empower everyone with the data and AI skills essential for 21st-century success. By providing practical, engaging learning experiences, DataCamp equips learners and organizations of all sizes to harness the power of data and AI. As a trusted partner to over 17 million learners and 6,000+ companies , including 80% of the Fortune 1000, DataCamp is leading the charge in addressing the critical data and AI skills shortage.

About the role

As part of our mission to make data and cloud fluency accessible to all, you’ll lead a dynamic team of instructors, content creators, and technologists to craft cutting-edge courses and projects that shape the future of cloud education. Cloud technologies are transforming how businesses operate, with platforms like AWS, Azure, and GCP at the forefront. As our Head of Cloud Curriculum, you’ll be instrumental in driving this transformation, helping learners worldwide build the skills they need to succeed.

In this role, you’ll own the cloud content strategy and roadmap, working hand-in-hand with our expert instructors and the broader Cloud Curriculum team — a talented group of educators, data scientists, and technologists. Your focus will be to continuously grow and enrich our cloud content library with impactful new materials. From courses to practice pools to real-world projects, you’ll serve as a thought partner, reviewer, and passionate advocate for our learners.

With a strong technical foundation in platforms like AWS and Azure, and the ability to influence across functions, you\'ll make data-driven decisions and successfully lead complex, high-impact projects. If you have a genuine passion for cloud education and are excited to shape the next generation of cloud professionals while building the world\'s premier network of cloud instructors, this role is for you.

About you

At DataCamp, we look for individuals who embody our core values: data-driven action, transparency, ownership, and an unwavering focus on our learners. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-performing environment and are driven by a passion for democratizing access to data and cloud technologies.

Your entrepreneurial mindset and collaborative spirit push you beyond simply meeting targets — you’re motivated to empower learners worldwide to succeed in an increasingly cloud-first world. You\'re a true team player who enjoys working across functions: whether you\'re partnering with internal engineering, product, marketing, sales, and support teams, or rolling up your sleeves to strategize directly with clients, you bring energy and curiosity to every collaboration.

You believe that people, processes, technology, and data are the essential ingredients for digital transformation — and you\'re energized by the opportunity to help learners advance their cloud knowledge and skills. If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you!

Responsibilities

In this role, you will focus your time on the following areas:

  • Define the Vision: Set the strategy for our Cloud Curriculum roadmap (AWS, Azure, GCP, cloud engineering, DevOps, and beyond).
  • Lead and Inspire: Manage a talented team of content developers and collaborate with external experts to create best-in-class learning experiences.
  • Stay Ahead of the Curve: Monitor industry trends and emerging cloud technologies to keep our curriculum at the forefront.
  • Drive Impact: Build engaging, practical learning paths that help learners unlock career opportunities and enable enterprise teams to scale cloud adoption.
  • Collaborate Cross-functionally: Partner closely with product, marketing, and enterprise teams to ensure our curriculum meets the evolving needs of learners and customers.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of management experience, leading teams to success.
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience in cloud platforms like AWS or Azure.
  • Proficiency in SQL and/or Python.
  • Familiarity with cloud architecture, services, and industry best practices.
  • Cloud certifications (AWS and/or Azure) are a plus but not required.
  • Passion for working collaboratively with subject matter experts and cross-functional partners.
  • Experience with interactive technical education platforms like DataCamp or similar.
  • Ability to synthesize, visualize, and clearly communicate complex ideas, including to non-technical audiences.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect
description:
Overview

Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect

Location: Brazil / Argentina (Remote)

Long term contract

Job Summary

We are seeking a visionary Automation Senior Cloud Solution Architect to lead the technical design and implementation of this transformative capability. This role is pivotal in architecting a scalable, AI-driven solution that seamlessly integrates advanced data processing, intuitive web interfaces, and intelligent automation.

This position demands a strategic leader who thrives in complexity and is deeply committed to cultivating strong stakeholder relationships. You will play a key role in fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration, guiding cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that drive pricing transparency, operational efficiency, and market competitiveness.

The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of technical depth and strategic foresight, with a proven track record of leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver end-to-end automation at scale. The role will interface with Enterprise Architecture, Business leaders, Senior Leaders and Cyber / Privacy / Legal teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI / CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.

Key Qualifications and Experiences

Technical Expertise :

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI / CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI / CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP / REST) and API development.
  • NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.
  • Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.
  • Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.
  • Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.
  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.

Specialized Skills

  • Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.
  • Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.
  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.

Soft Skills and Others

  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect
description:
Overview

Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect

Location: Brazil / Argentina (Remote)

Long term contract

Job Summary

We are seeking a visionary Automation Senior Cloud Solution Architect to lead the technical design and implementation of this transformative capability. This role is pivotal in architecting a scalable, AI-driven solution that seamlessly integrates advanced data processing, intuitive web interfaces, and intelligent automation.

This position demands a strategic leader who thrives in complexity and is deeply committed to cultivating strong stakeholder relationships. You will play a key role in fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration, guiding cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that drive pricing transparency, operational efficiency, and market competitiveness.

The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of technical depth and strategic foresight, with a proven track record of leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver end-to-end automation at scale. The role will interface with Enterprise Architecture, Business leaders, Senior Leaders and Cyber / Privacy / Legal teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI / CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.

Key Qualifications and Experiences

Technical Expertise :

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI / CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI / CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP / REST) and API development.
  • .NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.
  • Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.
  • Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.
  • Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.
  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.

Specialized Skills :

  • Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.
  • Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.
  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.

Soft Skills and Others :

  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect
description:
Overview

Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect

Location: Brazil / Argentina (Remote)

Long term contract

Job Summary

We are seeking a visionary Automation Senior Cloud Solution Architect to lead the technical design and implementation of this transformative capability. This role is pivotal in architecting a scalable, AI-driven solution that seamlessly integrates advanced data processing, intuitive web interfaces, and intelligent automation.

This position demands a strategic leader who thrives in complexity and is deeply committed to cultivating strong stakeholder relationships. You will play a key role in fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration, guiding cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that drive pricing transparency, operational efficiency, and market competitiveness.

The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of technical depth and strategic foresight, with a proven track record of leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver end-to-end automation at scale. The role will interface with Enterprise Architecture, Business leaders, Senior Leaders and Cyber / Privacy / Legal teams.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI / CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.

Key Qualifications and Experiences :

Technical Expertise :

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI / CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI / CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP / REST) and API development.
  • .NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.
  • Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.
  • Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.
  • Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.
  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.

Specialized Skills :

  • Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.
  • Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.
  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.

Soft Skills and Others :

  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.

Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.

Job responsibilities

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends

Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships

Knowledge

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors

Skills

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)

Attitude

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

title: Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect
description:
Overview

Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect

Location: Brazil / Argentina (Remote)

Long term contract

Job Summary: We are seeking a visionary Automation Senior Cloud Solution Architect to lead the technical design and implementation of this transformative capability. This role is pivotal in architecting a scalable, AI-driven solution that seamlessly integrates advanced data processing, intuitive web interfaces, and intelligent automation.

This position demands a strategic leader who thrives in complexity and is deeply committed to cultivating strong stakeholder relationships. You will play a key role in fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration, guiding cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that drive pricing transparency, operational efficiency, and market competitiveness.

The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of technical depth and strategic foresight, with a proven track record of leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver end-to-end automation at scale. The role will interface with Enterprise Architecture, Business leaders, Senior Leaders and Cyber / Privacy / Legal teams.

Responsibilities

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI / CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.

Qualifications

Technical Expertise :

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI / CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI / CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP / REST) and API development.
  • .NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.
  • Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.
  • Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.
  • Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.
  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.

Specialized Skills :

  • Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.
  • Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.
  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.

Soft Skills and Others :

  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

description:
Overview

About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.

Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends

Knowledge

  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors

Skills

  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)

Attitude

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team

  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

description:
Descrição

Posição Gerencial

Jornada de trabalho : Tempo integral com flexibilidade

Acomodação : A P&G está comprometida em fornecer acomodações a qualquer candidato com deficiência durante o processo de recrutamento, avaliação e seleção. Se você precisar de uma acomodação relacionada à sua deficiência para participar do processo de recrutamento, para enviar sua solicitação. Em caso de solicitação você não deve completar nenhuma avaliação até que tenha sido contatado para verificação de documentação .

Estamos em busca de Gerentes de Vendas Jr para colaborar e contribuir com nossa equipe de Vendas no Brasil, agregando aos valores de Liderar, Vender e Vencer.

Equipe de vendas externas (Campo)

  • Promover, desenvolver e manter um relacionamento produtivo de longo prazo com seu cliente e ser o elo entre eles e as equipes internas.
  • Adquirir um profundo entendimento das necessidades e requisitos do cliente, alinhado ao conhecimento aplicado dos compradores, categorias e do mercado.
  • Negociar contratos, planos promocionais e inovações através da execução de estratégias e mensagens de marketing, trabalhando em conjunto com áreas internas.
  • Preparar previsões de volumes, planos e métricas para análise de dados de Vendas.
  • Planejamento financeiro para pagamento de clientes.

Equipe de vendas internas (Estratégia de vendas)

  • Desenvolver estratégias para o negócio relacionadas às necessidades dos consumidores, para gerar insights sobre comportamento, tendências, correlações e sugestão de planos de ação quando necessário.
  • Adquirir um profundo entendimento das necessidades e requisitos do canal / categoria, alinhado ao conhecimento aplicado dos principais stakeholders no mercado (shoppers, consumidores, players de GTM, proprietários de lojas e segunda força de vendas).
  • Criar estratégias de trade e fundamentos de vendas para um canal / marca.
  • Preparar previsões de volume e planejamento financeiro de acordo com as métricas e objetivos gerais da Empresa / Canal / marca.
  • Traduzir e comunicar estratégias internas em planos e iniciativas comerciais.

Principais habilidades necessárias :

Pensamento estratégico e analítico forte, Comunicação, Inteligência Emocional, Senso de Propriedade e Produtividade, Colaboração, Curiosidade e Criatividade, Agilidade de Aprendizado, Paixão por Vendas e Liderança com Coragem.

Job Qualifications

  • Experiência prévia em Vendas, considerando relacionamento ativo com clientes.
  • Inglês Intermediário
  • Pacote Office intermediário / avançado (em particular Excel)
  • Conhecimento desejável em Power BI e Knime
  • Carteira de Habilitação ativa
  • Mobilidade para se deslocar dentro do Brasil ao longo da carreira
  • Segurança na Estrada : Para posições de Vendas, os funcionários são elegíveis para a política de veículo e combustível como ferramenta de trabalho. Com isso, é obrigatório ter a Carteira de Habilitação ativa.

Sobre a P&G :

A P&G é a maior empresa de bens de consumo embalados do mundo. Temos operações em mais de 75 países, com 65 marcas confiáveis que melhoram a vida de 5 bilhões de consumidores em todo o mundo. Isso traz muitas vantagens, incluindo a oportunidade para nossos funcionários desfrutarem de uma carreira diversificada e recompensadora, cheia de novos e empolgantes desafios.

Somos um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e valorizamos a diversidade em nossa empresa. Nossa missão de Igualdade e Inclusão é : "Todos valorizados. Todos incluídos. Todos desempenhando ao máximo."

Buscamos os talentos mais diversos para que possamos sempre inovar e superar as expectativas de nossos consumidores. Oferecemos desafios significativos desde o primeiro dia e treinamento eficaz e constante. Assim, aproveitamos as forças de nossos funcionários e os desenvolvemos para se tornarem líderes fenomenais, alcançando os mais altos níveis de gestão. Trabalhar conosco é a melhor oportunidade para fazer o que você ama, com desafios constantes e ser reconhecido pelos seus resultados. Mais do que isso, é a oportunidade ideal para nos ajudar a tocar e melhorar bilhões de vidas em nosso mundo.

Por mais de 175 anos, construímos algumas das marcas mais bem-sucedidas do mundo, incluindo Always, Ariel, Aussie, Clearblue, Downy, Gillette, Head and Shoulders, Oral-B, Pampers, Pantene e Vick.

Benefícios :

  • Salário compatível com o mercado
  • Vale refeição
  • Seguro de vida
  • Plano odontológico
  • Ações da P&G
  • Plano de poupança
  • Arranjos de trabalho flexíveis
  • Programas de bem-estar (massagem antiestresse, nutricionista, apoio psicológico, etc.)
  • Benefício de atividade física (Gympass)
  • Benefício de medicamentos e reembolso de vacinas
  • E outros...

Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under immense pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. To succeed long-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients.

Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

Managers play a vibrant, integral role at Huron. Their invaluable knowledge reflects in the projects they manage, and the teams they lead. As change leaders, our Managers build long-standing partnerships with clients, while collaborating with colleagues to solve our clients’ most pressing business challenges. Huron Managers shape and deliver results that seamlessly align with client goals, visions and missions. Remarkably versatile, our Managers also spend significant time mentoring junior staff on the engagement team—where they share expertise as well as feedback and encouragement. This benefits Huron profoundly as it promotes a culture of respect, unity, collaboration, and personal achievement.

As a Manager, you will have the unique ability to specialize in certain areas that showcase and employ your areas of expertise while gaining exposure to a breadth of capabilities across our performance improvement practice. Huron is big enough to offer the opportunity and exposure you need for your career growth—but small enough to give you individual attention needed for professional development. Every colleague contributes to who we are as an organization—and the more you evolve, the more we do. Create your future at Huron.

  • Impactful and professional written and verbal communication skills; ability to set clear project team direction, develop key deliverables, escalate risks, and influence key stakeholders inclusive of client and internal senior leadership

  • The ability to travel based on client, enterprise, or project needs is an essential function of this role. While travel requirements may vary based on business need, the current average travel in the Healthcare practice is less than 50%, annually
  • Exceptional leadership and management skills aligned with our core values
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written
  • Ability to quickly establish trust and collaboration with clients and colleagues
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
  • Experience in a matrixed organization
  • US Work Authorization required

Additional Job Description

The estimated base salary range for this job is $140,000 - $170,000. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay for performance philosophy. Inclusive of annual incentive compensation opportunity, the total estimated compensation range for this job is $161,000 - $212,500. The job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental and vision coverage and other wellness programs. Sobre a função

Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Suporte que atue diretamente com clientes Enterprise/B2B em um ambiente técnico altamente complexo. Essa pessoa será responsável por auxiliar os clientes com integrações às nossas APIs, lidar com incidentes críticos e garantir um atendimento técnico de alta qualidade para clientes estratégicos. Você será um ponto de referência tanto para o cliente quanto para o time interno, atuando como facilitador entre as áreas de suporte e produto.

Suporte técnico especializado:

  • Fornecer suporte técnico de nível avançado para clientes enterprise, lidando com integrações complexas e oferecendo soluções personalizadas para suas demandas;
  • Manter um relacionamento próximo com os clientes estratégicos, antecipando suas necessidades e garantindo uma excelente experiência de suporte;
  • Garantir um atendimento de alto nível, alinhamento com os direcionamentos técnico-jurídicos da unidade de negócio.

Análise e solução de problemas:

  • Estruturar dados para fins de diagnósticos de problemas, analisar logs e resolver falhas técnicas rapidamente;
  • Colaborar com os times de produto e desenvolvimento para garantir que os problemas dos clientes sejam solucionados de maneira eficiente e definitiva, dentro dos níveis de serviço acordados.

Resolução de incidentes críticos:

  • Atuar diretamente na identificação e na resolução de incidentes críticos de clientes enterprise, incluindo ocorrências de grande impacto para carteiras estratégicas;
  • Ser capaz de conduzir reuniões e videoconferências com clientes estratégicos e o time de produto, explicando a origem do problema e garantindo a mitigação rápida dos impactos.

Educação e gerenciamento de problemas nas integrações de APIs:

  • Ser responsável por guiar integrações técnicas entre nossos endpoints e os de grandes clientes, assegurando o sucesso das implantações e o bom funcionamento a longo prazo;
  • Resolver ou saber escalar para o time correto problemas técnicos relacionados aos nossos produtos e APIs (autenticação, tokens de acesso, chamadas de API com falhas, etc), utilizando ferramentas como Metabase, JIRA e afins.

Requisitos

  • Experiência de no mínimo dois anos em suporte técnico.
  • Experiência com resolução de incidentes críticos e condução de reuniões via videoconferência com clientes.
  • Conhecimento básico sobre bancos de dados SQL e ferramentas para análise e resolução de problemas.
  • Experiência e/ou certificações em ferramentas de gerenciamento como JIRA e Zendesk e ferramentas de automação como Google Colab e Apps Script.

Esta é uma vaga afirmativa para pessoas com deficiência (PCDs). Acreditamos que times diversos são mais fortes, criativos e representativos da sociedade. Por isso, buscamos intencionalmente atrair e incluir profissionais com deficiência em nosso time, promovendo um ambiente acessível, respeitoso e com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento.

O documento deve estar assinado e validado por profissional com CRM, e será analisado conforme os critérios estabelecidos nos artigos 89 e 90 da Instrução Normativa MTP nº 2, de 08/11/2021.

Ao fornecer essas informações, você declara que elas são verdadeiras e compreende que, em casos de incompatibilidade entre o laudo apresentado e os requisitos legais da vaga afirmativa, isso poderá ser considerado no processo de avaliação e eventual não preenchimento da posição.

Esta é uma vaga para o nosso banco de talentos, que está sempre aberto para conhecer novas pessoas. Por ser uma vaga de cadastro, não temos previsão para retorno imediato, mas manteremos seu perfil em nosso radar para futuras oportunidades.

We’re seeking a hands-on Senior Product Owner who owns the product end-to-end (discovery → definition → delivery → post-launch) and acts as the daily bridge between stakeholders and developers. About Infobel Pro

Infobel Pro is a leading provider of large-scale B2B, Point of Interest (POI), and B2C data. We empower businesses globally with comprehensive, accurate, and actionable data to drive their sales, marketing, and analytical efforts. As we continue to expand, we are looking for a technically adept and commercially-minded Sales Engineer to join our team and serve as a crucial link between our powerful data products and our clients’ business needs.

The Role

As a Data Sales Engineer, you will be a key player in our sales process, acting as the primary technical resource for our sales team and a trusted advisor to our prospective clients. You will be responsible for understanding the complex data challenges of our prospects and demonstrating how Infobel Pro’s solutions can solve them. This role is perfect for someone with a strong technical background, a passion for data, and a consultative, business-oriented mindset.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Pre-Sales Support : Collaborate with the sales team to understand prospect requirements and articulate the technical and business value of our data solutions.
  • Data Sample Preparation : Prepare and deliver custom data samples for prospects, which involves matching tens of thousands of records and requires proficiency in SQL (e.g., using DuckDB) and Python to leverage our internal matching APIs.
  • Product Expertise : Serve as the subject matter expert on Infobel Pro’s data offerings. You will be expected to explain our data products and enrichment processes at a deep technical level to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Solution Design : Work with clients to design and propose data solutions that meet their specific needs, ensuring they derive maximum value from our products.
  • Client Communication : Build strong relationships with prospects by providing expert guidance, answering technical questions, and ensuring a smooth pre-sales experience.

What You Bring

  • A strong technical background, ideally from a STEM field or equivalent practical experience.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis, with experience handling large datasets. Experience with tools like DuckDB is a plus.
  • Good command of Python for scripting, data processing, and interacting with APIs.
  • Good communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • A business-oriented mindset, with the ability to connect technical features to business value. Experience in a client-facing role (e.g., consulting, sales engineering) is highly desirable.
  • A proactive, problem-solving attitude and the ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

What We Offer

  • A growing company with a strong vision
  • Competitive pay

  • Supportive team culture focused on learning, ownership, and impact
  • Remote work environment

In order to successfully perform the essential functions of this job the employee must be able to verbally communicate with employees, co-workers and customers online and by phone.

Faça parte do CNPEM!

No Centro Nacional de Pesquisa em Energia e Materiais (CNPEM), somos movidos pela paixão pela ciência. Nosso ambiente é um vibrante centro de pesquisa e desenvolvimento, onde profissionais de diversas especialidades se conectam para enfrentar desafios complexos e criar soluções para problemas relevantes, especialmente nas áreas de saúde, energia, materiais renováveis e sustentabilidade.

Somos uma Organização Social supervisionada pelo Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação (MCTI), na vanguarda da pesquisa científica no Brasil. Somos responsáveis pelo Sirius, a maior infraestrutura científica já construída no País, e atualmente, desenvolvemos o projeto Orion, um complexo laboratorial dedicado a pesquisas avançadas em patógenos, que estará disponível para a comunidade científica nacional e internacional.

Oferecemos uma ampla gama de oportunidades de carreira para profissionais de diferentes perfis. No CNPEM, conduzimos pesquisas de ponta que abrangem nanotecnologia, biociências, biotecnologia, biorrenováveis, instrumentação científica e física de aceleradores, conduzidas, respectivamente, pelos Laboratórios Nacionais de Nanotecnologia (LNNano), Biociências (LNBio), Biorrenováveis (LNBR) e Luz Síncrotron (LNLS). Essas iniciativas são fortalecidas por projetos tecnológicos desafiadores e pela busca de soluções na fronteira das engenharias, liderados pela Diretoria Adjunta de Tecnologia (DAT).

Todo esse ecossistema é sustentado por uma rede integrada de áreas estratégicas que inclui tecnologia da informação, comunicação, gestão de projetos, assessoria jurídica & compliance, recursos humanos, finanças, compras, sustentabilidade e inovação, alocadas entre Diretoria Geral (DG) e Diretoria de Serviços Compartilhados (DSC). A Diretoria Adjunta de Infraestrutura (DAI) assegura a manutenção das instalações, o suporte à engenharia e o desenvolvimento arquitetônico, criando condições ideais para o avanço de todas as atividades.

A Ilum Escola de Ciência complementa essas frentes com um curso de bacharelado em Ciência e Tecnologia, oferecendo uma formação inovadora que prepara novas gerações de cientistas para os desafios do futuro.

Acreditamos que o sucesso é alcançado por meio de dedicação, colaboração e propósito claro. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo dos nossos profissionais e estudantes, oferecendo um ambiente inspirador e favorável para o crescimento profissional e pessoal.

Estamos comprometidos com a sustentabilidade e buscamos soluções que promovam um futuro mais verde. Prezamos pelo cuidado e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, ao mesmo tempo em que valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas e respeitadas.

Se você é apaixonado por ciência e busca um lugar onde você possa fazer a diferença, junte-se a nós no CNPEM.
