title: Seo Strategist / Head Of Seo
description:
Overview


We are seeking a highly skilled and visionary SEO Strategist / Head of SEO to define and lead our search growth roadmap. In this senior role, you will be responsible for setting the overall SEO direction, prioritizing initiatives that drive business impact, and aligning organic growth efforts with company-wide objectives.


As a T-shaped marketer, you will combine deep SEO expertise with a broad understanding of marketing, analytics, and digital growth. You will work closely with leadership, product, design, content, and development teams to ensure SEO is embedded across every function of the business. The ideal candidate is both analytical and creative, capable of developing data-driven strategies while inspiring cross-functional teams to execute at the highest level.



Responsibilities



  • Strategy & Leadership

    • Define the organization’s SEO vision, long-term growth roadmap, and execution strategy.

    • Design and implement comprehensive SEO initiatives across technical SEO, content strategy, link-building, and experimentation.

    • Evaluate and prioritize opportunities based on ROI, complexity, and competitive landscape.

    • Align SEO objectives with overarching business KPIs, including marketing qualified leads (MQLs), customer acquisition cost (CAC), annual recurring revenue (ARR), and pipeline velocity.

    • Continuously monitor search engine trends, algorithm updates, and industry best practices to maintain a competitive advantage.

    • Champion SEO within the organization, ensuring buy-in from stakeholders and visibility at the leadership level.



  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

    • Partner with product and development teams to ensure SEO requirements are factored into platform architecture, site migrations, and new feature rollouts.

    • Work with content and editorial teams to build a scalable framework for keyword-driven, high-performing content.

    • Collaborate with design and UX / UI teams to ensure website changes and new templates support both usability and SEO performance.

    • Align closely with marketing and demand generation teams to integrate SEO into campaigns, events, and broader growth initiatives.

    • Build strong relationships across departments to foster a culture where SEO is considered a critical growth lever, not a siloed function.



  • Performance Tracking & Reporting

    • Establish a robust measurement framework for SEO, defining clear KPIs and success benchmarks.

    • Use analytics tools (GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Looker Studio) to monitor performance, identify opportunities, and track progress.

    • Deliver detailed reporting to leadership on keyword growth, traffic trends, conversion impact, and revenue attribution from SEO.

    • Translate complex SEO data into actionable insights and recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.

    • Identify gaps in analytics or reporting and collaborate with data teams to enhance measurement accuracy.



  • Team & Vendor Management

    • Build and lead an SEO team (in-house or distributed), ensuring a balance of technical expertise, content strategy, and off-page authority building.

    • Manage external SEO agencies, freelancers, or consultants, ensuring alignment with internal goals and quality standards.

    • Mentor and upskill team members across departments, fostering greater SEO literacy throughout the organization.





Qualifications



  • Must-Haves

    • 4+ years of proven SEO strategy and leadership experience, ideally in a tech-driven environment.

    • Demonstrated track record of scaling organic channels to deliver measurable business results (e.g., revenue growth, lead generation, or market expansion).

    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and make data-driven decisions.

    • Proficiency in SEO and analytics platforms, including GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, and Looker Studio.

    • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence executives and cross-functional peers.

    • Deep understanding of how SEO intersects with broader marketing, product, and sales strategies.



  • Nice-to-Haves

    • Experience managing SEO at scale for international or enterprise-level websites.

    • Familiarity with CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization), paid media, and marketing automation tools.

    • Hands-on experience with technical SEO concepts such as schema markup, JavaScript rendering, and Core Web Vitals.

    • Background in leading distributed teams or managing agency partnerships.





Why Join Us?


This is a rare opportunity to take ownership of a mission-critical growth channel at a pivotal stage in our company’s expansion. As Head of SEO, you will shape not only our search performance but also how SEO informs and strengthens the broader go-to-market strategy. You will be empowered to make high-level decisions, experiment with innovative approaches, and directly impact the scalability of our business.

title: Inside Sales Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a motivated and detail oriented Inside Sales Specialist to join our Life Sciences sales team. This role is critical in driving revenue growth across Crown Bioscience's full portfolio of pre-clinical and translational oncology services, including organoids, in vivo and in vitro models, biomarker discovery, human biospecimens, and integrated drug discovery solutions.

The Inside Sales Specialist will develop strong client relationships, manage the inside sales cycle, and support business development initiatives with biotech, pharma, and academic researchers worldwide. By promoting Crown Bioscience's world-leading preclinical platforms, cancer databases, and precision oncology offerings, this role ensures scientists have the tools they need to accelerate discoveries in cancer diagnostics and therapeutics.

Importantly, the Inside Sales Specialist will work with Prendio, a third-party procurement platform for the biotech industry, to help generate biotech leads, manage referrals from their preferred supplier network, and strengthen the partnership relationship.

Key Responsibilities

  • Sales & Business Development
    • Proactively identify, qualify, and manage inbound and outbound sales opportunities across Crown Bioscience's full portfolio (organoids, in vivo/in vitro models, biomarkers, human biospecimens, etc.).
    • Manage the full inside sales cycle: lead generation, prospect engagement, needs assessment, quoting, negotiation, and closing.
    • Collaborate with SDRs and field-based Business Development Directors to support client acquisition, account expansion, and long-term growth.
    • Serve as the primary inside sales contact for Prendio-generated biotech leads.
    • Consistently achieve and exceed assigned sales targets, contributing directly to company revenue goals.
  • Customer Engagement
    • Serve as the first point of contact for researchers, biotech, pharma, and CRO clients seeking preclinical and translational oncology solutions.
    • Build strong, trust-based relationships by understanding client needs and recommending tailored Crown Bioscience offerings.
    • Deliver accurate and timely information regarding service capabilities, project feasibility, and proposal details.
    • Provide outstanding customer service throughout the sales cycle, ensuring client satisfaction and repeat business.
  • Operational & Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Partner with operations, scientific, and project management teams to ensure feasibility, accuracy, and timely delivery of client projects.
    • Maintain detailed records of client interactions, pipeline activity, and forecasts within the CRM system.
    • Share market and customer feedback with internal stakeholders to help refine and expand service offerings.
    • Collaborate closely with external partners like Prendio to maximize lead generation opportunities and strengthen biotech outreach.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Business, or related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in inside sales, customer success, or business development in life sciences, biotechnology, or CRO sectors.
  • Strong communication, relationship-building, and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed sales targets.
  • Highly organized with attention to detail and experience using CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).
  • Self-motivated team player with a proactive approach and passion for supporting oncology research.

Preferred Requirements

  • Advanced degree (MSc, MBA, or equivalent) in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field.
  • 3+ years of inside sales or business development experience in oncology or precision medicine services.
  • Strong understanding of preclinical workflows (organoids, in vivo/in vitro models, biomarkers, biospecimens).
  • Experience working with or managing leads from third-party platforms (e.g., procurement networks such as Prendio).
  • Background in supporting biotech, pharma, or CRO clients with complex research needs.

Salary Range: $70,000 - $90,000

About the Role

The Partner Channel Enablement Specialist is the primary resource dedicated to empowering the SOVOS organization to successfully sell and support Tungsten Automation's Invoice Agility and Total Agility product suite. This role leverages deep technical expertise and partner enablement experience to deliver impactful training, develop core enablement content, and support joint partner events and summits. Partner Channel Enablement Specialists require close collaboration with SOVOS counterparts, the Tungsten Automation Partner Organization, and the Tungsten Automation Product Team.

What You0;ll Do

  • Design and deliver comprehensive training programs for SOVOS teams, ensuring deep understanding of Tungsten's Invoice Agility and Total Agility offerings and value propositions
  • Create, maintain, and update enablement materials—includ­ing presentations, playbooks, FAQs, and technical guides—tailored to the needs of SOVOS sales and technical and support teams
  • Plan and execute enablement sessions at partner events, summits, and workshops, representing Tungsten Automation and driving engagement
  • Act as a subject matter expert, providing pre-sales technical support, objection handling, and solution positioning to help SOVOS close deals involving Tungsten products
  • Serve as the bridge between SOVOS, Tungsten Automation's Partner Organization, and the Product Team to ensure alignment on strategy, messaging, and product updates
  • Gather feedback from SOVOS and internal teams to continuously improve enablement programs and product positioning

About Our Platform

Tungsten Automation software enables organizations to "Work Like Tomorrow-today." Our Intelligent Automation software platform is unique in the marketplace, helping financial institutions, insurance companies, and healthcare organizations transform information-intensive business processes, reduce manual work and errors, minimize costs, and improve customer engagement. We combine RPA, cognitive capture, process orchestration, mobility and engagement, and analytics to ease implementations and deliver dramatic results that mitigate compliance risk and increase competitiveness, growth and profitability—particularly crucial for highly regulated industries facing complex compliance requirements. No other software vendor offers a platform of complementary technologies integrated into a scalable, manageable software platform, positioning us to grow and dominate the process automation space.

While the job description describes what is anticipated as the requirements of the position, the job requirements are subject to change based upon any changing needs and requirements of the business.

Required Experience

  • Demonstrated mastery of Tungsten Automation's product suite, with ability to articulate technical and business value to diverse audiences
  • 5+ years in partner enablement, channel management, or sales enablement roles within the software or automation industry
  • Strong technical background with ability to translate complex product features into clear, actionable insights for partner teams
  • Proven track record supporting sales teams in competitive, solution-oriented environments
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with experience working cross-functionally and across organizations
  • Experience developing high-quality enablement content and delivering engaging training sessions
  • Experience working with or within SOVOS or similar tax compliance and automation organizations preferred
  • Familiarity with financial process automation, RPA, and digital transformation solutions preferred
  • Ability to travel for partner events and summits as needed
  • Strong work ethic and commitment to long-term success
  • Team-oriented and entrepreneurial mindset

Tungsten Automation Corporation, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/Disability/Vets

The base salary range for this role, across the US, is $109,251 - $153,999. Your actual base pay within this range will be determined by your work location as well as skills, qualifications, experience, and relevant education/training. The range provided reflects only the base salary for the role and does not include benefits.

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master’s or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.

description:
Overview

Main responsibilities

  • Conduzir a migração de rotinas SAS legadas para o novo ecossistema Data Mesh, com foco em modernização, padronização e governança de dados;
  • Compreender a malha batch existente via Control-M, analisando dependências, componentes SAS e estruturas de dados envolvidas;
  • Realizar a transpilação dos códigos SAS para Spark, utilizando AWS Glue e garantindo aderência aos padrões técnicos do Mesh;
  • Criar e configurar ambientes de origem e destino (buckets S3, schemas, conexões), assegurando o fluxo completo dos dados na AWS;
  • Desenvolver Glue Jobs robustos, parametrizados e com testes unitários, promovendo estabilidade e escalabilidade nas entregas;
  • Executar processos em produção, documentar fluxos e apoiar o repasse para sustentação;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa em ambiente ágil, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia e integração contínua.

Requirements and skills

  • Sólido conhecimento em Python e Spark, com foco em desenvolvimento de pipelines de dados;
  • Profundo conhecimento com AWS Glue, S3, Lambda, Step Functions e Athena, Redshift;
  • Familiaridade com orquestração de tarefas com Control-M;
  • Experiência com versionamento (Git/GitHub) e ambiente Linux;
  • Conhecimento de Terraform para infraestrutura como código (IaC);
  • Capacidade analítica para entendimento de código legado e adaptação aos novos padrões do Data Mesh;

We work hard in a fast-paced professional environment that will challenge you to learn and grow, and we play hard through team lunches and events that give back to the community. TEECOM is one of the fastest growing companies in the San Francisco Bay Area, with additional teams in New York City, the United Kingdom, the Pacific Northwest, Southern California, and Texas. Join us and make TEECOM even better.

About the Position

As a high-level BIM Specialist, the BIM Specialist II is part of the production team that supports all levels of the engineering team across multiple disciplines. This individual supports or manages the process of virtually constructing a building and documenting the design contract from the construction documents set through record drawing submittals. It is their responsibility to manage the models, conduct BIM planning, and ensure collaboration, coordination, and accuracy on all projects. They serve as the go-to person on the project for modeling, documentation, and verifying design intent.

As the person responsible for QA/QC on projects, this individual must learn the fundamentals of technology systems such as telecommunications infrastructure, cabling, audiovisual, security, acoustics, and wired and wireless networks. They will therefore participate in the TEECOMuniversity in-house training program, including Bridge courses and one-on-one or group sessions. They will participate in, create, and provide feedback on the Revit trainings in the TEECOM Documentation.

Impact

  • Represent TEECOM Values and Guiding Principles: Individual demonstrates that they CARE about clients and fellow team members, adds VALUE, and earns and builds TRUST.
  • Deploy Technical Expertise: Individual has demonstrated expert skills in their trade and is able to succeed on their own as well as review, correct, and direct other technical staff to produce exemplary output (documents, etc.).
  • Augment Company-Wide Communication: Individual demonstrates a commitment to elevating company-wide communication by enhancing internal documentation, fostering team collaboration, and supporting transparency across the firm.

Influence

  • Lead by Example: Individual sets the example for the team by aligning their actions with their words.
  • Indirect Mentorship: Individual provides indirect mentorship to anyone who asks questions or needs guidance.
  • Technical Expertise: Individual has a deep knowledge of their discipline that is supported by continuing education and certifications.

Knowledge

  • Knowledge of the AEC industry and the design and construction of technology systems such as telecommunications infrastructure, cabling, audiovisual, security, acoustics, and wired and wireless networks.
  • Small to mid-sized construction projects ($100,000+ TEECOM fee) involving a multitude of disciplines with both long and fast-track timeframes (years or months) in various industry verticals (mission critical, healthcare, workplace, transportation, higher ed, government, industrial, cultural, etc.).
  • Familiarity and experience with working with others discipline teams (architectural, electrical, mechanical, structural, and civil).
  • Knowledge of the AEC industry and the design and construction process are a plus.

Skills

  • Organization: Keep track of multiple projects and client and team member requests, often on a last-minute basis with excellent follow-up to assure promises are kept.
  • Documentation: Thoroughly documents, updates, and maintains process documentation, notes, and decisions across appropriate platforms to ensure workflows, processes, and discussions are accessible and up-to-date.
  • Communication: Conduct business communications in an effective, professional, and concise manner, both verbally and in written formats, and in one-on-one, small-group, and large-group settings. You must read, write, speak, compute, and problem-solve various tasks. Break down complex concepts into smaller and more digestible components that allow for a greater level of understanding by others.
  • Teamwork: Work as a functional member of a team and successfully work with other teams and business functions to achieve positive results. Facilitate effective project team and cross-functional interactions (Technical, Operations, BD, Marketing, etc.).
  • Problem Solving: Approach problems using a methodical and logical method to create a workable solution. Use numbers and mathematical approaches for various tasks. Conduct research using the Internet.
  • Software: Use software applications effectively and efficiently (G Suite, MS Office, Bluebeam, Slack, Revit, AutoCAD MEP,Navisworks, Bluebeam Studio, etc.) to communicate and deliver work products.
  • Process Oriented: Follow processes, continually seek to make processes more efficient, enforce processes, and conduct root cause analyses that lead to the update or creation of processes.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Learn the building design process and the pursuit process
  • Participate in BIM-related forums and user groups to discover new techniques; identify upcoming changes within the AEC industry with regards to the evolution of BIM processes
  • Foster client relationships and fellow design team members and ensures all contact information and important discussions are documented in TEECOM's CRM
  • Ask clients about other current or upcoming projects
  • Attend client and/or industry events
  • Assist in schematic design, design development, and construction documentation for a variety of projects
  • Assist with the production of accurate and detailed construction documents in AutoCAD and Revit for one or more disciplines
  • Assist with clients, consultants, and BIM team regarding BIM standards/processes, and if necessary, document project BIM standards/processes for distribution to the project team
  • Assist with project production effort in a fast-paced and collaborative environment
  • Assist with the coordination of schedules and resources around project work to complete tasks on time
  • Assist with BIM quality assurance and quality control by reviewing project BIM standards at various phases of the project so they adhere to TEECOM standards and client project requirements
  • Participate in project BIM coordination meetings: spatial coordination of disciplines, gathering discipline BIM models
  • Assist with clash detection and conflict resolution
  • Assist with methods for electronic information transfer
  • Identify and recommend automation tools, scripts, or other 3rd-party software tools to reduce the production time
  • Regularly document, update, and maintain team-related processes, workflows, and best practices. Actively initiate and participate in discussions about project challenges, process improvements, and other topics that enhance internal documentation and contribute to the team's success and collaboration
  • Perform other work-related duties as assigned
  • Support teams with workload and assist where needed
  • Assist and update training materials for TEECOMuniversity and GitHub/Bridge as well as training sessions for the various Autodesk software
  • Ensure timesheets/expense reports are accurate and up-to-date daily
  • Achieve billed revenue target each quarter

What Success Looks Like in this Role

  • Utilization equals 85%
  • Average hours worked is between 40 and 50 hours per week
  • Achieve goals from the Performance Plan each quarter
  • Quarterly reviews are completed on schedule
  • Complete 100% of Asana tasks on time
  • Time management
  • Able to identify and prioritize tasks
  • Make few if any mistakes (checking own work), mistakes are not repeated after correction
  • Meet deadlines
  • Manage time well, planning ahead, not asking for help at last minute
  • Actively engage with GitHub repositories, Callback One, Design Decision Logs, and other pertinent platforms by consistently contributing valuable documentation and participating in discussions to enhance internal documentation and team collaboration.
  • Able to work under pressure and tight deadlines
  • Problem-solving and organizational experience and a focus on continuous improvement

Experience

  • Associate Degree in a related field or Technical Certificate in Drafting, or related field
  • Bachelor's Degree in Architecture or Engineering is a plus
  • Minimum two years as BIM Specialist or BIM Technician
  • Minimum two years of professional Autodesk product use and support (Revit Architecture, Revit MEP, AutoCAD or AutoCAD MEP)
  • Bluebeam Studio
  • Microsoft Office 365 Suite
  • G Suite

Certifications

  • Autodesk Certificate(s) is a plus

$90,000 - $120,000 a year

This compensation will vary depending on your role-related skills, experience, knowledge, and subject matter expertise. TEECOM is committed to making sure that we are the right fit for each applicant and that each applicant is the right fit for our team. As we get to know each other throughout the interview process, the compensation may vary within the stated range.

TEECOM offers a comprehensive benefits package to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees and their dependents, basic and voluntary life insurance, short-term and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan with profit-sharing contributions, paid parental leave, lifestyle and legal benefits, pet benefits, and performance-based bonuses. Full-time exempt team members also enjoy flexible time off, and all employees receive nine scheduled paid holidays.

Your level will be evaluated and determined during the interview process. Please submit your resume and a cover letter.

XDRhub is a specialized sales and business development outsourcing company. This role is highly outbound-driven: you will spend your time cold calling, cold emailing, prospecting via LinkedIn, and using modern sales tools to generate meetings. You’ll run early-stage discovery conversations and hand off qualified opportunities to the sales team.

  • Work in an Agile Environment: Operate effectively within our agile development framework, contributing to continuous improvement and quick iterations.
  • Present and Gather Feedback: Engage with stakeholders to present completed data products and gather valuable feedback for further iterations.
  • Own the Solution: Take ownership of complex data problems from start to finish, from identifying the root cause to implementing a production-ready solution.
  • Conduct regular performance audits on existing data pipelines, databases, and dashboards, and implement optimizations.

title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Soluções, Startup
description:
Você gosta de startups? Tem interesse em computação em nuvem? Temos uma posição para você.
As startups são as grandes empresas do futuro. Estas jovens empresas são fundadas por pessoas ambiciosas que desejam construir algo significativo e desafiar o status quo seja para atender novos clientes ou para desafiar os atuais. Geralmente operam em um ambiente de escassez: seja de capital, recursos de engenharia ou experiência. É aqui que você entra.
A equipe de arquitetura de soluções de inicialização da AWS se dedica a trabalhar com essas empresas que estão em estágio inicial à medida que elas constroem seus negócios. Estamos aqui para garantir que eles possam implantar as melhores, mais escaláveis e mais seguras arquiteturas possíveis – e que gastem o mínimo de tempo e dinheiro possível fazendo isso.
Procuramos construtoras técnicas que amam a ideia de trabalhar com startups em estágio inicial para ajudá-las à medida que crescem. Nesta função, você trabalhará diretamente com clientes interessantes e os ajudará a tomar as melhores (e às vezes mais pragmáticas) decisões técnicas ao longo do caminho. Você terá a oportunidade de construir relacionamentos duradouros com essas empresas e se estabelecer como um consultor confiável.
Temos mais de 200 serviços em diversas categorias diferentes e é importante que possamos ajudar as startups a aproveitar as vantagens dos serviços certos. Você também desempenhará um papel importante como defensora de nossas equipes de produtos para garantir que estamos construindo os produtos certos para as startups com as quais você trabalha. E para os clientes com os quais você não trabalha individualmente, terá a oportunidade de compartilhar seu conhecimento de forma mais ampla, trabalhando em conteúdo técnico e apresentando-se em eventos.

Key job responsibilities
- Envolver-se diretamente com pessoas clientes iniciantes para fornecer-lhes apoio técnico à medida que constroem seus produtos na nuvem. Certifique-se de que eles estão gastando o mínimo de tempo e dinheiro possível fazendo isso;
- Criar planos, em conjunto com outros membros das equipes de contas do cliente, para definir como você ajudará as pessoas clientes com suas necessidades de nuvem;
- Compartilhar amplamente seu conhecimento técnico participando de sessões selecionadas, focadas em startups, com uma pessoa e em grupos maiores de clientes;
- Trabalhar com outras equipes na AWS (por exemplo, marketing, treinamento) para contribuir para a criação de conteúdo que possa ser entregue à comunidade mais ampla de startups em escala (por exemplo, vídeos on-line e outros conteúdos digitais).
A day in the life
Como membro do líder mundial para este espaço empolgante e de crescimento rápido, você terá a oportunidade de ajudar a impulsionar o crescimento e moldar o futuro de uma categoria de serviço que terá um impacto significativo em nossos clientes de modelo global de computação. Nossa equipe valoriza muito o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional. Não se trata de quantas horas você passa em casa ou no trabalho: é sobre o fluxo que você estabelece que traz energia para ambas as partes da sua vida. Acreditamos que encontrar o equilíbrio certo entre sua vida pessoal e profissional seja fundamental para a felicidade e a realização ao longo da vida. Oferecemos flexibilidade no horário de trabalho e encorajamos você a encontrar seu próprio equilíbrio entre o trabalho e a vida pessoal.
About the team
Aqui na AWS, abraçamos nossas diferenças. Estamos empenhados em promover nossa cultura de inclusão. Temos dez grupos de afinidade liderados por funcionários, alcançando 40.000 funcionários em mais de 190 capítulos globalmente. Temos ofertas de benefícios inovadores e hospedamos experiências de aprendizado anuais e contínuas, incluindo nossas conferências Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) e AmazeCon (diversidade de gênero). A cultura de inclusão da Amazon é reforçada em nossos 16 Princípios de Liderança, que lembram os membros da equipe a buscarem diversas perspectivas, aprenderem e serem curiosos e ganharem confiança.
About the team
Experiências Diversas
A AWS valoriza experiências diversas. Mesmo que você não atenda a todas as qualificações e habilidades preferenciais listadas na descrição do cargo, incentivamos os candidatos a se candidatarem. Se sua carreira está apenas começando, não seguiu um caminho tradicional ou inclui experiências alternativas, não deixe que isso o impeça de se candidatar.
Por que a AWS?
A Amazon Web Services (AWS) é a plataforma de nuvem mais abrangente e amplamente adotada do mundo. Fomos pioneiros na computação em nuvem e nunca paramos de inovar — é por isso que os clientes, desde as startups mais bem-sucedidas até as empresas da Global 500, confiam em nosso robusto conjunto de produtos e serviços para impulsionar seus negócios.
Cultura de Equipe Inclusiva
Aqui na AWS, está em nossa natureza aprender e ser curiosos. Nossos grupos de afinidade liderados por funcionários promovem uma cultura de inclusão que nos permite ter orgulho de nossas diferenças. Eventos e experiências de aprendizado contínuos nos inspiram a nunca parar de abraçar nossa singularidade.
Mentoria e Crescimento Profissional
Estamos continuamente elevando nosso padrão de desempenho enquanto nos esforçamos para nos tornar o Melhor Empregador da Terra. É por isso que você encontrará aqui compartilhamento de conhecimento sem fim, mentoria e outros recursos para o avanço da carreira para ajudá-lo a se desenvolver como um profissional mais completo.
Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal

We’re seeking an Amazon Graphics Designer to craft premium, on-brand visuals that boost click-through and conversion for skincare products. You’ll transform product USPs and ingredient benefits into clean, conversion-oriented imagery across hero images, feature callouts, comparison charts, and A+ content. This role is ideal for a designer who loves partnering with marketing, testing ideas, and pushing for the best creative outcomes.

A growing beauty and skincare e-commerce brand focused on premium, science-informed products and exceptional customer experience on Amazon.

  • Design high-performing Amazon listing visuals (hero images, feature callouts, comparison charts, A+ content) optimized for CTR and conversion

  • Advanced skills in typography, layout, and visual storytelling with meticulous attention to detail

Why Join Us?

Work on beautiful, premium skincare brands where your creative decisions directly impact visibility and sales. Join a collaborative team that values thoughtful pushback, testing, and continuous learning—where you’re encouraged to teach, challenge assumptions, and help raise the bar on Amazon-first design.

title: Analista de Operações de Marketplace
description:
Overview

O que é a nstech?

A nstech é a mais completa plataforma open logistics do mundo, construindo o futuro digital do transporte de cargas junto a todo o ecossistema logístico. Nosso objetivo é conectar e transformar a cadeia logística, oferecendo centenas de soluções integradas em um único lugar. Acreditamos no poder da tecnologia para melhorar o mundo, reduzindo a emissão de CO2, acidentes e roubos.

Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados e determinados para se juntarem a nós como Analista de Operações de Marketplace . Se você tem vontade de aprender, transformar a logística e mobilidade e fazer a diferença, essa é a sua oportunidade!

Main responsibilities

  • Monitorar e otimizar o processo de onboarding de compradores e fornecedores, garantindo rampagem rápida e eficaz;
  • Acompanhar SLAs de atendimento e performance de uso da plataforma, atuando para corrigir desvios;
  • Suportar os processos de atendimento, faturamento, cobrança e conciliação de pedidos, minimizando erros;
  • Analisar indicadores críticos do marketplace, como: Taxa de resposta de fornecedores, tempo de fechamento de cotações, GMV e taxa de ativação e engajamento de clientes;
  • Gerar relatórios e análises para a liderança, sugerindo melhorias em processos e fluxos operacionais;
  • Atuar como referência técnica em operações, garantindo eficiência do time e satisfação dos clientes;
  • Participar de testes de novas funcionalidades e apoiar o time de produto;
  • Realizar atendimentos e treinamentos multidisciplinares para clientes e stakeholders;
  • Garantir integração e correta utilização de múltiplos sistemas no dia a dia.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Economia, Logística, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em operações de marketplace, e-commerce ou SaaS;
  • Vivência em processos de onboarding, atendimento e billing/cobrança;
  • Experiência com análise de dados operacionais e acompanhamento de indicadores de desempenho;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Excel (nível intermediário ou avançado);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de CRM e atendimento (Moviedesk, HubSpot, Huawei ou similares).

Será um diferencial se:

  • Já tiver atuado na área de Compras, com conhecimento de fluxos de negociação e relacionamento com fornecedores.

Additional information

O que esperamos de você:

Na nstech, temos uma cultura baseada em valores e esperamos que todos os nstechers não apenas se identifiquem, mas também vivam essa cultura em seu dia a dia. Acreditamos que a cultura é uma das maiores vantagens competitivas para negócios bem-sucedidos, pois é algo que não pode ser copiado integralmente.

Nossos pilares culturais e seus atributos são:

• Servir: foco no cliente, humildade, transparência e ética

• Equipe: valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a vontade de colocar a mão na massa e o espírito colaborativo

• Resultados: buscamos agilidade, melhoria contínua, geração de valor a longo prazo e foco nos resultados

Por que trabalhar na nstech?

Temos a visão de ser a plataforma de tecnologia para logística e mobilidade que conecta os elos e gera mais valor para os negócios da rede integrada de logística da América Latina. Atualmente, contamos com uma equipe de mais de 3500 nstechers comprometidos em melhorar o mundo por meio da tecnologia aplicada à logística e mobilidade. Estamos empenhados em gerar impacto para a sociedade, clientes, colaboradores e acionistas, e queremos somar forças com pessoas cheias de energia e propósito para fazer parte de nossa equipe e dessa transformação. Além disso:

  • Você trabalhará com uma equipe que desenvolve a maior plataforma de logística da América Latina.
  • Nosso ambiente de trabalho é altamente colaborativo, e adoramos compartilhar conhecimentos. Aqui, você terá oportunidades de desenvolvimento técnico.

title: Senior Product Owner
description:
Senior Product Owner

Location: Remote

Contract: PJ (full-time)

Level : Senior

We’re building a virtual office platform for remote and hybrid teams. It brings together persistent rooms, real-time presence, audio / video (WebRTC), chat, screen sharing, collaborative boards, and immersive spaces to boost connection, productivity, and team cohesion — all in one place.

We’re seeking a hands-on Senior Product Owner who owns the product end-to-end (discovery → definition → delivery → post-launch) and acts as the daily bridge between stakeholders and developers. Beyond roadmap and prioritization, you will test the product, hunt bugs, propose improvements, and run competitor research to turn insights into shipped value.

What You’ll Do

  • Daily communication (English): Lead daily standups in English with developers and stakeholders; drive alignment, clarify scope, and ensure follow-through to delivery.
  • Backlog & delivery ownership: Plan OKRs / roadmap; break initiatives into epics / stories; manage risks, dependencies, timelines, and quality.
  • Jira & Confluence discipline (non-negotiable): Keep Jira 100% accurate (statuses, owners, dates, links).
  • Create extremely well-documented tickets: clear problem statement, context, scope / out-of-scope, acceptance criteria, functional & non-functional requirements, edge cases, steps to reproduce, logs / screens, links to Figma and related docs.
  • Enforce Definition of Ready / Done and maintain Confluence specs / decisions up to date. (Developers should never complain about unclear tickets again.)
  • Ensure planned dates for Stage and Production are set on relevant Jira issues and reflected in views / boards.
  • Discovery & definition: User interviews, usability tests, JTBD mapping; author PRDs / specs with crisp acceptance criteria.
  • Quality & testing: Perform exploratory testing, reproduce issues, triage, and file actionable bug cards.
  • Continuous improvement: Track activation / engagement / retention, run A / B experiments, and prioritize UX / performance / stability improvements.
  • Competitor research: Benchmark features / flows and translate findings into opportunities and prioritization.

Reporting & rituals

  • Daily stakeholder report (every business day) consolidating, per developer:
  • What was completed today.
  • The current task and ETA for completion.
  • The next 3 tasks with planned start / end dates.
  • Tasks that moved to Stage today (and which developer).
  • Tasks that moved to Production today (and which developer).
  • Mirror this view in Jira dashboards / filters with Stage / Prod target dates visible.
  • Maintain AI-generated minutes of every daily with summaries stored in Jira (and linked in Confluence).
  • Friday report includes the weekly summary and the monthly developer performance evaluation when applicable.

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years in Product Ownership / Product Management (senior) with a track record of shipping and iterating successfully.
  • Fluent English — capable of leading daily standups in English, writing specs, and aligning requirements with international stakeholders.
  • Software development experience (prior engineering role strongly preferred) or equivalent technical background — comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, and reading code / PRs at a high level.
  • Proven follow-through: nothing falls through the cracks; you drive clarity to outcomes.
  • Tooling (required): Jira, Confluence, Figma, Slack, Google Sheets.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to WebRTC / A/V concepts, performance tuning, or growth loops.
  • Certifications: CSPO, Pragmatic, Agile.

Overview

About Sofia Health

Sofia Health is a fast-growing wellness marketplace connecting clients with top health and wellness professionals. Through live classes, on-demand content, and 1 : 1 services, we’re making whole-person care more accessible and helping providers build thriving businesses.

Sofia Prime is our flagship wellness membership, offering 300+ live virtual classes every month focused on physical, mental, and emotional well-being—including yoga, meditation, fitness, tai chi, iRest, health coaching, and more.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Bonus Points
